CheckTitle: BMS instances should not use the default security group
Description: Ensure that Bare Metal Server (BMS) instances are not using the default security group, which may have overly permissive rules.
Risk: The default security group may contain overly permissive rules that allow unrestricted access to BMS instances, increasing the risk of unauthorized access.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console
2. Navigate to Elastic Cloud Server
3. Select the BMS instance
4. Click More > Manage Security Group
5. Remove the default security group
6. Add a custom security group with appropriate rules

Recommendation.Text: Replace the default security group with a custom security group that has least-privilege rules.
